描述_EN: this element seems to come from the same piece as no. 2001.1.37, which has identical decoration. fragment of a monochrome tapestry square inserted into a linen canvas. the square is highlighted on the inside by a thin frame of ecru edging, framing four stylized plant motifs, each foot of which is placed on one side of the frame. the flowers meet in the center of the rectangle. On the sides, in rectangle length, both flowers are larger than those on opposite sides.
描述_ZN: 本件似乎来自第2001.1.37号的同一件作品，其装饰完全相同。 单色挂毯方形碎片插入亚麻帆布中。 广场的内部由一个细长的框架强调，该框架由灰褐色的边框构成，框内有四个风格化的植物图案，每个脚都放在框架的一侧。 花在长方形的中心相遇。 在侧面，在长方形的长度上，两朵花比对面的花大。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
